ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (dark/black) background with discrete, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing less than 5% of the total surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the top-most edge, exhibiting multiple pixel-level peaks and valleys distinct from the water interface.
